external_services.purpose: Setup downloads SenseVoice model files; hf-mirror.com is the fallback mirror.

local: Runs the transcription engine locally with Python and CPU; setup creates a private virtual environment and downloads the model.
Uses local absolute media paths; optional ffmpeg is used for non-WAV formats.
